messages:
Ravi: Heads up everyone 1 important procurement updates rolling out next week. Short version below, full doc linked. :megaphone:

Ravi: 1) New expedited vendor onboarding lane for low-risk SaaS (turnaround target: 48 hrs). 2) Prepay card pilot for project teams 18 month trial; apply via the portal. 3) SLAs: standard vendor review remains 5 business days.

Ravi: Full guide: <https://redwood.internal/finance/procure-updates|procurement updates>. Please read if you submit vendor forms.

FinanceOpsBot: Automated note 1 expedited lane eligibility: non-PII SaaS, non-infrastructure, <$15k annual spend. Submit "Expedite Request" checkbox on vendor form.

Sofia: Question: for the prepay card, who holds liability? Is there a monthly reconciliation cadence?

Ravi: Good Q. Liability stays with Redwood card program. Teams will reconcile weekly in Concur and monthly card statements will be routed to project owners. We'll add a dedicated reconciliation report in the portal.

Liam: For infra purchases (cloud, hosting, GPUs) is there any change? We have security requirements for kernels and SSH access vendors.

Ravi: Infra is excluded from expedited lane. All infra vendors still need security review + legal signoff for contracts. That hasn't changed.

PeopleOps: Can we get a short blurb to include in new-hire welcome so managers know about the prepay card pilot?

Ravi: Yep 1 will send a 3-line summary and link to apply. Also scheduling procurement office hours next Tue 10-11am for live Q&A.

Sofia: Any thresholds for who can request a prepay card? Manager approves, right?

Ravi: Request flow: team lead requests -> finance ops reviews budget alignment -> card program issues card. Limits set per project; default limit $5k, can request higher with director signoff.

FinanceOpsBot: Reminder: all vendor forms without tax docs will be auto-pended after 72 hours. (automated at 1797007930)

Liam: Noted. Also, in the portal can we mark vendors as "approved for test env only"? That helps sandbox purchases.

Ravi: Good idea 1 we'll add a checkbox for "sandbox-only" approvals; procurement will honor that in contract clauses.

Sofia: Thanks Ravi. When does this take effect?

Ravi: Expedited lane + prepay card pilot start Monday 2026-04-06. Standard SLAs apply for anything not eligible.

PeopleOps: I'll include the blurb and sign-up link in onboarding and ping managers today.

Ravi: Awesome. Ping me or @FinanceOps if you hit edge cases. :pray:
